entities.name: runaway horse, front half lost
entities.what: A horse galloping west at full stretch (the bolting horse of 惊马闯市), its hind legs flung out straight behind it to the east. Only the back, the haunch, the belly line and the hind legs survive, faint; the head, neck and forelegs are lost to damage, with a dark smudge where the chest was. No saddle, bridle or load can be seen on what remains. Three grooms run after it from the east (S1.grp.runaway_horse).
entities.vis: part: front half lost to damage
entities.note: Painted extents: back line u 30100-30193, v 763-787 (the haunch's hump at 30155-30195); belly line 30120-30197, v 827-837; hind legs stretched east-south-east to the hooves at (30230, 810) (far leg) and (30240, 855) (near leg); a dark smudge at 30083-30100, v 770-820 (the chest, or the edge of the damage). Nothing of the head, neck or forelegs is painted west of u ~30080. The hooves are off the ground in the gallop: hind = the ground under the near hind hoof (v 858, the level of the near hoof). fore and head are est from a galloping horse's shape (forelegs reaching about 160 px ahead of the hind hooves, head at about the back's height). Painted height back to hoof ~95 px (its chasers are 98-111 px). SCALE CUE: 162 px from the chest smudge (30083) to the hind hooves (30245), legs stretched. The tile restyle redraws it as a small beast with a pack (a pig or a loaded donkey); the strokes show a galloping horse with stretched legs. Read on contrast and high-pass crops at zoom 3.

entities.name: groom running after the bolting horse (nearest)
entities.what: Groom in a short jacket and trousers running west after the bolting horse, his right arm thrust straight out to the west at shoulder height and his rear leg flung out behind him; a large round thing sits at his back and shoulders, either a broad hat blown back on its strings or a cloth bundle tied at the shoulder with its ends flying.
entities.note: Small head 30320-30337, v 685-705, face to the west; arm out to (30272, 696). The round thing at his back: 30335-30370, v 673-705, with two short flying ends at (30370-30383, 693-705). Both readings, conf med: a broad hat hanging at his back on its strings (it sits behind the head, not on it), or a cloth bundle (the tile restyle draws a big bundle on his back). Front foot planted at (30327, 782); rear foot lifted at (30380, 752), ground under it ~(30380, 783): foot = midpoint. Painted height 98 px to the head (109 px to the top of the round thing). Read at zoom 4-6 (natural and high-pass).

entities.name: groom running after the bolting horse (middle), half behind a willow
entities.what: Groom in a dark cap and short jacket running west after the horse with his arm thrust straight out to the west; from the waist down he is hidden among the long whips of the great willow's crown.
entities.vis: part: below the waist hidden by the whips of the great willow (base about (31165, 1495), t3's)
entities.note: Cap 30502-30527, v 695-705; arm out from (30500, 717) to (30457, 718); body 30500-30535 down to v ~760, then willow whips. Foot est from the other two chasers' painted height (98-111 px): v ~800 under the body. Whether he runs or walks can't be read (legs hidden); the arm matches the other two chasers.

entities.name: groom running after the bolting horse (farthest east)
entities.what: Groom in a dark cap, a short jacket and a short apron at the waist, running west at full stride with his left arm thrust out to the west, his front knee bent high and his rear leg stretched far behind him.
entities.note: Cap top (30662, 572); arm out to (30605, 602); jacket 30645-30697, v 588-638; apron 30672-30690, v 638-657. Front foot planted at (30652, 680); rear foot at (30740, 686), lifted: foot = midpoint. Painted height 111 px. The willow whips of the great willow's crown start just below his rear foot.

entities.name: man with a stick and bundle at the west end of the travellers
entities.what: Man in a long robe and a soft cap standing at the west end of the travellers on donkeys, facing east toward the riders, holding in front of his chest a short stick from which a long dark bag or bundle hangs (a traveller or the riders' servant).
entities.note: Head 29987-30020, v 1287-1320, face in profile to the east; robe 29975-30017 down to the feet at (29980, 1474) and (30010, 1472). Painted height 189 px. The object east of him, 30022-30067, v 1325-1400 (a rounded top at 30022-30040, v 1325-1345, a long hanging shape at 30040-30055, v 1340-1400, a stick end at (30067, 1357)), is read as his stick and bundle. The tile restyle reads it as a second man (bearded, with a staff and a bag) behind him: no second pair of feet is painted (the ground at 30030-30060, v 1460-1480 is blank), so one figure. Both readings, conf med. His feet are west of t1's range end, but t2 is the travellers' named owner.

entities.name: hooded traveller on the first donkey

Hooves: hind (30117, 1497) near and (30158, 1483) far, fore (30198, 1510) and (30235, 1502); fore and hind = the midpoints. entities.what: Man in a short padded jacket, trousers and a small topknot cap walking east between the two riders, a long staff over his right shoulder and a dark curved bundle or cape hanging at his back (a servant or porter of the travellers).

entities.name: hooded traveller on the second donkey
entities.what: Second traveller bundled against the cold, a hood pulled over his head and a cloak round his shoulders, riding the donkey S1.ani.donkey_traveller_30546 east; a man at the donkey's head leads it (S1.fig.groom_leading_donkey_30648).
entities.note: Hood top (30500, 1367), face (30500, 1407); seat about (30495, 1510). foot = ground under the seat (est), on the donkey's hoof line. The tile restyle puts 4-5 people round him: the strokes show only him, the man with the staff to the west and the man at the donkey's head.

entities.name: second travellers' donkey
entities.what: Donkey with a bristling mane walking east under the hooded rider S1.fig.traveller_rider_30495; its head is hidden behind the man who leads it by a rope (S1.fig.groom_leading_donkey_30648).

entities.name: man leading the second donkey
entities.what: Stout man in a long robe and a topknot cap, painted from the front with an open-mouthed face, standing at the second donkey's head and holding its lead rope in both hands at his waist (the travellers' groom, or a traveller leading the donkey).
entities.note: Head top (30655, 1442), cap knot 30660-30680, v 1445-1462; face frontal, mouth at (30647, 1482); hands together at 30650-30692, v 1522-1538 on the rope from the donkey's head. The tile restyle draws one walker as two here (at the tile edge).

entities.name: willow-decked sedan chair of the tomb-sweeping party
entities.what: Sedan chair decked with willow (杨柳杂花装簇轿顶), carried west-south-west down the upper track: a tall, closed, dark box (its east side darker than its west face) with a low roof and a knob finial; a big spray of about 6-8 long willow twigs fans up and out to the west from the roof's west corner, more willow strands hang down its west face, and a few twigs stand at its east corner. No flowers can be told apart at this size. Carried on poles at shoulder height by a front bearer (west) and a rear bearer (east); no wheels. The passenger is not painted (the box is closed).
entities.vis: part: the bottom of the box and the bearers' feet among the great willow's whips
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)
entities.note: Box u 30867-30937; finial (30890, 423); roof eave v 430-443; bottom v 573-587 (bottom west corner (30890, 580), bottom east (30933, 575)). Willow spray 30823-30873, v 415-487 (west); hanging strands 30840-30883, v 450-550; twigs 30933-30950, v 433-467 (east). SCALE CUE: box 70 px wide in u, 155 px from finial to bottom; the bearers are ~115 px tall. One pole line shows, from the front bearer's shoulder (30805, 537) past the box at v 517-530 to the rear bearer's shoulder (31010, 478). DEPTH DIRECTION (the pole line, at shoulder height, not at ground level): (30805, 537) -> (31010, 478), slope dv/du -0.29: the rear end lies north-east of the front, so the sedan heads west-south-west (facing ~205, an estimate from that slope). front/rear = ground under the poles' ends, v from the bearers' feet (est; the front bearer's feet are hidden). The tile restyle stacks jars and a basket on it and adds a child under the poles: invented. sections.md says a woman rides inside; nothing of her is painted, so no figure is recorded.

entities.what: Sedan bearer in a dark cap at the front (west) end of the sedan's poles, the pole on his shoulder, walking west-south-west with his face to the west; only his head and upper body show above the great willow's whips.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden by the great willow's whips
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)

entities.name: porter with two boxes on a pole, beside the rider
entities.what: Porter in a cap and short jacket carrying a pole across his shoulders with a tall dark box or basket hanging at each end (food hampers for the tomb offerings?), walking beside the rider at the top of the party.
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)
entities.note: Cap top (30905, 249); west box 30874-30884, v 252-282; east box 30922-30936, v 276-305; feet (30923, 325) and (30893, 332) (the west foot faint): foot = midpoint. Painted height 80 px. entities.name: rider of the tomb-sweeping party
entities.what: Man in a tall peaked hat (a pointed crown and a wide brim) and a robe, riding the horse S1.ani.horse_party_31023 at the top of the tomb-sweeping party, holding the reins in front of him; horse and rider are painted facing east.
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)

Head to ground 125 px. Only one rider is painted in the party (sections.md: 'a rider').

entities.name: the party rider's horse
entities.what: Light-bodied horse drawn in dark outline, walking east with its head and bridle at the east end and its tail raised and flowing at the west end, a saddle cloth under its rider (S1.fig.rider_party_30988).
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)
entities.note: Head 31005-31030, v 268-292, with a dark ear tuft at (31023, 273); tail 30937-30951, v 276-321 (its dark tip at (30949, 321)). Hooves: hind (30959, 352) near and (30993, 340) far; fore (31011, 353) far and (31036, 364) near; fore and hind = the midpoints. It faces east, against the sedan party's westward walk below it: as painted (the rider may be turning back, or the upper track runs east). Read at zoom 3-5 on the scan and on high-pass crops. The overview restyle puts a groom at its head: the strokes there are the horse's head and two forelegs, with no second torso; the tile restyle draws three men. Horse rather than donkey (short ears, long raised tail, size): conf med. SCALE CUE: 97 px from tail to muzzle; back at v ~280, hooves 340-364 (~80 px).

entities.name: willow on the bank above the chasers (west of a pair)
entities.what: Willow of the willow_fan form, the west one of a pair standing 80 px apart on a bank above the chasers: a slender dark trunk leaning a little east forks at about two thirds of its height into knobbly heads that throw fans of long, straight, bare shoots up to near the top of the silk; early spring, no leaf painted.
entities.note: Base where the trunk meets the bank line at v ~521 (trunk foot 30622-30652). Fork and heads 30652-30690, v 348-404. Its shoots interlace with those of S1.tree.willow_fan_30712. One trunk. Painted height ~420 px.

entities.name: willow on the bank above the chasers (east of a pair)
entities.what: Willow of the willow_fan form, the east one of the pair: a slender dark trunk rising nearly upright to knobbly heads with fans of long straight bare shoots that spread east over the party's track; early spring, no leaf.
entities.note: Trunk foot 30698-30722, v 487-494. Fork and heads 30729-30768, v 333-379. One trunk. Painted height ~390 px.

entities.name: far pollard willow up the slope
entities.what: Far willow (willow_fan, a far crown) up the slope north of the chasers' bank: a dark knobbly pollard head throwing a fan of fine bare shoots in all directions; its short trunk is faint.
entities.note: Pollard head 30500-30552, v 171-235. Below it a darker smudge runs down-west to about 30480-30510, v 225-270, just above the far fields' diagonal edge (S1.grd.banked_fields_30400 `diag`, second pass: measured at (30370, 266) -> (30550, 381); the line given here before, (30406, 256) -> (30583, 379), has no stroke under its west half): the trunk's foot est there, conf low on the base. The tile restyle draws a man in blue climbing in the tree: the strokes show only the knotted head and its shoots. Read at zoom 4.

entities.name: far shrub crowns at the silk's top edge
entities.what: Far shrubs or small tree crowns cut by the silk's top edge: dark knotted blotches in a row along the edge (u 30830-30920), like the far crowns the painter dots along a distant ridge.
entities.vis: part: cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Blotches at 30830-30860, v 25-50 (the largest), 30865-30885, v 25-33 and 30890-30920, v 25-38. One clump of 1-3 shrubs, or moss dots (苔点) on a far ridge (then it is ground, structures_w's). Nothing but faint wash below them. Base est at the foot of the blotches. The tile restyle draws a fallen branch here. Read at zoom 4.

entities.name: far tree crown at the silk's top edge
entities.what: Far tree or shrub crown cut by the silk's top edge: a cluster of dark knotted blotches (u 30955-31015) like a far pollard head or a bush on the far ridge.
entities.vis: part: cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Blotches 30955-31015, v 23-43. A slanting dark stroke runs below and west of it from (30925, 40) to (30970, 75): a far slope's edge (ground, structures_w's) or this tree's leaning trunk (the tile restyle draws a small tree on a mound with its trunk there). Or moss dots on the ridge. Base est at the foot of the blotches. MERGE: possible duplicate in disguise: t3's S1.tree.willow_far_31190 has its long west limb reaching about (30950, 40), and on the merge's zoom-3.5 crop that willow's whips run up-left to about u 31000 at the top edge, where this tree's knotted blotches sit. SECOND PASS (west): not the willow's twig ends; keep. At zoom 3-3.5 these blotches are knotted dark dots (u 30963-30989, v 24-50, and 30991-31011, v 30-42), the same mark as S1.tree.far_shrubs_30860's clumps (30831-30857, 30866-30883, 30891-30920): one row of far shrubs or moss-dotted crowns along the far ridge. S1.tree.willow_far_31190's west shoots are fine straight lines that thin out at about u 31000-31020, v 40-60, with no dots on them. The slanting stroke below is S1.grd.far_slope_30950 (second pass).

entities.name: A-frame trestle in the hut's fence opening
entities.what: An A-shaped frame of two crossed sticks (a trestle or a sawhorse) standing on the ground in the opening of the hut's wattle fence, with a short crossbar stroke above it.
entities.note: Legs from (30825, 1287) and (30857, 1290), crossing near the apex (30843, 1248); a short stroke at 30827-30840, v 1228. Other reading: a stooping figure (no head or body is painted, so conf low). The restyles read the opening differently (the tile: a pig and a man in blue; the overview: a bow-shaped frame). A thin upright at 30887-30903, v 1227-1277 and a few short strokes on the ground at 30880-30920, v 1283-1297 next to it look like the fence opening's post and a loose piece of fence: left to structures_w. Base = midpoint of the two feet. MERGE: the thin upright and the loose strokes beside it are recorded as the gate post of S1.str.wattle_fence_31100 (points gate_post_foot, gate_post_top).

entities.name: the runaway horse and its chasers (惊马闯市)
entities.what: A horse that has bolted gallops west toward the farmhouse and the village, and three grooms run after it in a line with their arms thrust out: the nearest about 110 px east of its haunch, the other two further east and up the slope behind. West of the farmhouse, on the open ground by the vegetable field, a man leaning on the bar of a tall post stretches his arm toward a small child, calling it out of the horse's way (t1's reading of the old man and the child the scholarship names).
entities.note: sections.md adds an old man calling a child away: t2 found no such pair within u 29900-31250 (its range); t1 found them west of it, the child at (29674, 1064) and the man at the post at (29812, 1114), about 300 px of v nearer the viewer than the horse and 260-400 px west of it. MERGE: t1's group S1.grp.old_man_child (the child, the man and the post he leans on) is folded into this group; that they react to the horse is the scholars' reading (conf med). That the horse is the tomb-sweeping party's is scholarship (余辉), not painted: no link is recorded.

entities.name: travellers on donkeys (迎寒策蹇 / 骑驴客商)
entities.what: Two travellers hooded against the cold ride east on donkeys along the lower track, a man with a staff and a bundle walking between them, a man leading the second donkey by its head, and a man with a stick and a hanging bundle standing at the west end facing them.
entities.note: 5 figures (2 riders, 3 on foot) and 2 donkeys, counted one by one at zoom 2.5-4. The tile restyle doubles the west walker and adds 4-5 people round the second rider: none of them are in the strokes.

entities.name: the tomb-sweeping party coming home (杨柳杂花装簇轿顶)
entities.what: The willow-decked sedan is carried west-south-west down the upper track by two bearers; a porter with a shoulder-pole load and a walker follow behind it to the north-east, and at the top a porter with two boxes on a pole walks beside a man on a horse (horse and porter painted facing east).
entities.src: 名画记: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (pin 6)
entities.note: One more member is t3's by his feet (u >= 31100): the man with a long staff slanting over his shoulder (second pass: its top ends in a small knob, no blade or tines drawn), cap top (31131, 359), feet (31150, 454) and est (31112, 450) behind the east load of S1.fig.porter_pole_31083, walking with the party between S1.fig.porter_walking_31070 and S1.fig.porter_pole_31083. MERGE: added as S1.fig.party_porter_staff_31131 (t3: foot (31131, 448), head (31132, 351); a long thin pole or staff slants over his shoulder). In all, with t3's man: 7 figures (2 bearers, 4 on foot, 1 rider), 1 horse, 1 sedan; no one is painted inside the sedan.
